mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2.5% YoY signals strengthening aggregate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate above 5% indicates tight monetary conditions, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: a low UNRATE below 4% signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of periods with UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when INDPRO growth exceeds 1.5% YoY and HOUST increases by > 5% MoM, the combined signal predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO YoY growth > 1.5% and HOUST MoM growth > 5%
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in triggered periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly RSAFS increase exceeding $50B signals strengthening consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of months with RSAFS MoM growth > $50B.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: a high CPIAUCSL above 300 signals elevated inflation expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of periods with CPIAUCSL > 300.

mechanism_narrative: Threshold-triggered: a PAYEMS increase of > 200k in a single month signals a strong labor market, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 50% of months with PAYEMS MoM growth > 200k.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: in a post-shock recovery regime, a 2% MoM increase in INDPRO predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window in post-shock recovery regimes, or 60-day forward returns in triggered periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
